questions.stem: An array has 10 elements, and the first one has index 0. What is the index of the last element?
questions.explain: Indices run from 0 to n − 1, so 10 elements end at index 9.

questions.stem:
What does this program print?

```python
a = [4, 1, 7, 2]
s = 0
for i in range(len(a)):
    if a[i] > 3:
        s += a[i]
print(s)
```
questions.explain: The loop visits each index. Only 4 and 7 are greater than 3, so s = 4 + 7 = 11.

questions.stem: A grid with 5 columns is stored row by row in one flat list. Rows, columns and flat positions all start at 0. Which (row, column) holds flat position 17?
questions.explain: 17 // 5 = 3 full rows come first, and 17 % 5 = 2 cells are left over, so the position is row 3, column 2.

questions.stem:
How many times does the counter increase? The program prints the final value of count.

```python
count = 0
for i in range(3):
    for j in range(4):
        count += 1
print(count)
```
questions.explain: The inner loop runs 4 times for each of the 3 outer passes, so 3 × 4 = 12.

questions.stem: How many times does the body of `for i in range(2, 9):` run?
questions.explain: range(2, 9) gives 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8. The end value 9 is not included, so the body runs 7 times.
